annotation.title_clean: Proposal for a Regulation amending Regulations (EU) 2021/694, 2021/695, 2021/697, 2021/1153, 2023/1525 and 2024/795 as regards incentivising defence-related investments in the EU budget to implement the ReArm Europe Plan
annotation.title_en: Proposal for a Regulation amending Regulations (EU) 2021/694, 2021/695, 2021/697, 2021/1153, 2023/1525 and 2024/795 as regards incentivising defence-related investments in the EU budget to implement the ReArm Europe Plan
annotation.summary_en: Commission proposal to amend six EU funding regulations so EU budget programmes can finance defence and dual-use investments under ReArm Europe. It adds defence technologies, including AI, drones and AI Gigafactories, as a fourth STEP strategic sector. It allows cohesion fund transfers and cumulative funding. It contains no AI safety or robot-specific governance rules.
key_provisions_or_claims: Adds 'defence technologies' as a fourth strategic sector in the STEP Regulation (EU) 2024/795.
Opens Horizon Europe's EIC Accelerator to dual-use and defence applications, as an exception to the civil-focus principle.
Lets Member States transfer shared-management cohesion funds to EDF, ASAP and CEF, with up to 100% co-financing for military mobility.
Extends the ASAP ammunition regulation to 31 December 2026.
Supports AI Factories and Gigafactories under Digital Europe and CEF, and allows dual-use calls to exclude third-country-controlled entities.
